summary_cn: 一款农舍主题的重新设计，旨在模仿日本乡村建筑风格。带有季节和天气效果。
summary: A farmhouse reskin meant to resemble rural Japanese architecture. Comes with seasonal and weather overlays.

author: Roszpunka1990
summary_cn: 5种不同颜色的独角兽。
summary: 5 different colors of unicorns

author: yuninocorn
summary_cn: 一座神奇的农场建筑，将四个传送方尖碑合并成一座紧凑的建筑，并提供多种美学变体可供选择。
summary: A magical farm building that merges the four warp obelisks into one compact building with several aesthetic variations to choose from.

author: Long
summary_cn: 一些中国风的窗户和屏风设计，灵感源于现实中的中国古建筑风格
summary: 一些中国风的窗户和屏风设计，灵感源于现实中的中国古建筑风格

author: VoidWitchCult
summary_cn: 将 HxW 中的可建造酒庄重新着色为紫色。
summary: Recolors the Buildable Winery of HxW into something Ourple.

title_en: A Yri-style bookseller and hot balloon
author: momo
summary_cn:
--简介--
这个模组将1.6新增的书商和热气球替换成欧式建筑样式，有白玫瑰装饰，专门搭配Yri的城镇大修。
除了书商旁边的热气球，哈维十心事件的热气球也有相应的美化。
summary:
--简介--
这个模组将1.6新增的书商和热气球替换成欧式建筑样式，有白玫瑰装饰，专门搭配Yri的城镇大修。
除了书商旁边的热气球，哈维十心事件的热气球也有相应的美化。

author: AtlasV
summary_cn: 讨厌整理物品。想要一个自动化的解决方案。这款模组正适合你。
summary: Hate sorting your items? looking for an automatic solution? this is the mod for you!

author: Tcocumi
summary_cn: 我终于完成了金色时钟，好好利用它来装饰你的家吧❤。
summary: I have finally completed Gold Clock, make full use of it to decorate your far❤

author: LCKa conversion of zilch and PaulDunstan
summary_cn: 热气球方尖碑回归 SDV 1.6 版本啦。现在有 CP 和 AT 两种版本。额外惊喜：方尖碑现在可以作为动态家具使用了。
summary: Hot Air Balloon Obelisks are back for SDV 1.6. Now in CP and AT versions. Bonus: the obelisks are now available as animated furniture!

author: plaidbees
summary_cn: 新增宝可梦作为新的农场动物，拥有闪亮皮肤、蛋和豪华商品。新增宝可梦包括：木木枭、小火龙、杰尼龟、妙蛙种子、波加曼、草苗龟、小火猴、皮丘及其进化型、谜拟Q、伊布进化型、大奶罐、毛毛角羊、烤猪头、六尾、九尾、泡沫栗鼠、三蜜蜂、蜂女王、太阳岩、月石、大葱鸭、向日花怪、向日种子、百变怪、玛机雅娜和未知图腾。
summary: Adds Pokemon as new farm animals, with shiny skins, eggs and deluxe goods. Adds Rowlet, Charmander, Squirtle, Bulbasuar, Piplup, Turtwig, Chimchar, Pichu + evos, Mimikyu, Eeveelutions, Miltank, Wooloo, Lechonk, Vulpix, Ninetails, Minccino, Combee, Vespiquen, Solrock, Lunatone, Farfetch'd, Sunflora, Sunkern, Ditto, Magearna and Unown!

author: silvermoonchan
summary_cn: Mistria 动物田野，现已登陆 SDV。
summary: Fields of Mistria animals, now for SDV!

author: DonValleyParkway silvermoonchan
summary_cn: 数码宝贝牧场已更新至 1.6 版本。
summary: Digimon Ranch updated for 1.6

author: Arrbyte
summary_cn: 添加了带有真实声音的爱情鸟~。
summary: Adds lovebirds with real sounds~

author: mondluna silvermoonchan jonbow
summary_cn: 将海豹添加为农场动物。
summary: Adds seals as a farm animal

author: NukaColaPrime silvermoonchan
summary_cn: 给你的农场添加企鹅。
summary: Adds penguins to your farm

author: Hisameartwork and TrentXV
summary_cn: 游戏中新增鱼类。查看列表了解更多信息。
summary: Adds new fish to the game. Check list to see more info.

author: xAncAx
summary_cn: 该模组为你的游戏添加了 25 种独特的生物，有些黑暗神秘，有些可爱迷人。
summary: This mod adds 25 unique creatures to your game, some dark and mysterious, some cute and adorable.

author: Nature - xAncAx
summary_cn: 让《星露谷物语》的世界充满生活气息，在石头下、泥土里、草丛中、树梢上寻找动物。这款模组新增了36种野生动物，从小型动物到毛茸茸的哺乳动物和爬行动物，应有尽有。
summary: Make the world of Stardew Valley feel lived in, find animals under rocks, in the soil, in the grass, in the tree tops. This mod adds 36 new integrated wild animals, from critters to fluffy mammals and reptiles.

author: otohimexoxo
summary_cn: 新增 30 多种宝可梦，可作为鱼类/采集物/蟹笼鱼（含闪光变种）。
summary: Adds 30+ Pokemon as fish/foragables/crabpot fish (+ shiny variants)

author: mytigio
summary_cn:
扩展了《艾维利亚的龙》中的龙，包括龙蛋、新的烹饪食谱、幼龙纹理等等。

现在，龙可以从独特的龙蛋中孵化出来，这些龙蛋可以在冒险者公会买卖。
summary:
Expands the Dragons in Everia's Dragons to include Dragon Eggs, new cooking recipes, baby textures and more.

Dragons are now hatched from unique dragon eggs, which can be bought and sold at the Adventurer's Guild.

author: Murrthecat silvermoonchan
summary_cn: BFAV 飞龙（用于 CP）。
summary: BFAV Wyverns for CP

author: XanCreations
summary_cn:
此模组使用 Nature In The Valley 框架，为《星露谷物语》添加了可捕捉的宝可梦。
该模组的目的不仅在于让玩家能够与宝可梦互动，还能让他们在《星露谷物语》的游戏框架内体验宝可梦的世界。
该模组将持续更新完善。
summary:
This mod adds catchable Pokémon to Stardew Valley using the Nature In The Valley framework.
The purpose of the mod is to not only allow players to interact with Pokémon but get a feel for it's world whilst still being grounded in Stardew Valley.
It will be expanded upon and continue to grow over time.

title_en: JP's Le Pets - Monsters of the Mines
author: Juanpa98ar
summary_cn: 现在你可以在玛妮的牧场领养怪物啦。好好对待它们，它们会给你带来珍贵的礼物。从小小的史莱姆到巨大的辣椒雷克斯，应有尽有。
summary: Now you can adopt monsters at Marnie's Ranch! Treat them well and they will bring you valuable gifts. From small Slimes to a huge Pepper Rex.

author: Jonbow
summary_cn: 新增袋鼠、斑马、犀牛、豪猪、食蚁兽、羚羊、长颈鹿、河马、驼鹿、霍加狓、穿山甲和貘作为家畜，新增几维鸟、琴鸟、兔耳袋狸、短尾矮袋鼠和跳鼠作为圈养动物。此外，还新增帐篷作为动物住所，可容纳未来可能加入的体型更大的动物。
summary: Adds Kangaroos, Zebra, Rhino, Porcupines, Anteaters, Antelope, Giraffe, Hippo, Moose, Okapi, Pangolins, and Tapirs as barn animals, Kiwi, Lyrebirds, Bilbies, Quokka, and Jerboa as Coop Animals. Also adds a Tent as animal housing which can accommodate larger animals which may come in the future.

author: ThaliaFawnheart
summary_cn: 有了这个模组，你现在可以邀请NPC跟随你，和你一起完成任务。在邻居的帮助下，你可以浇灌庄稼、砍伐树木、探索矿井等等。
summary: With this mod, you can now invite NPCs to follow you around and do tasks with you! Water crops, cut down trees, explore the mines and more with the help of your neighbors.

author: SmolHooman - plurffle
summary_cn: 为游戏添加一些野生动物（不包括其他模组添加的地点）。
summary: Adds some wild animals to the game (locations added from other mods not included).

author: Em and HarrisonGrey
summary_cn: 后期可饲养的水豚；会觅食物品并能与其它农场动物互动。
summary: Adds a capybara as a late game Barn Animal; forages items and pets other Farm Animals

author: Jeelh
summary_cn: 新增小精灵作为牲畜选项。
summary: Adds Junimos as a livestock option!

author: Ophaneom and Locked15
summary_cn:
为游戏增加一些生存几率，每种工具/食物都有不同的惩罚值和食物/水分值。
现在新增了许多选项。

并且支持 SDV 1.6。
summary:
Adds some survival odds to the game, with different penalty and feed/hydrate values to each tool/food!
Now with a bunch of new options.

AND WITH SUPPORT FOR SDV 1.6!

author: oclarina
summary_cn: 将《原神》世界中的 50 多种作物添加到《星露谷物语》中。
summary: Adds over 50 crops from the world of Genshin Impact to Stardew Valley.

title_en: Star Crops and Galaxy Rainbow Trees - Stardrop Tea Ancient Starfruit Fruit Sapling Mod
author: MissAnaira
summary_cn: 用酒桶酿造你自己的星辰茶。它会为游戏添加一棵银河树苗、两颗天界种子和四种宇宙作物。这些作物旨在帮助你在游戏后期发展，并提升友谊（星辰茶）、金钱（星辰种子）和增益效果（银河）。
summary: Brew your own Stardrop Tea in a keg! Adds a galactic sapling, 2 celestial seeds, and 4 cosmic crops to the game! These crOPs are meant to help with late game progression and help with friendship (Stardrop), money (ASF), and buffs (Galaxy). Obtainable via dangerous monster loot, Qi's walnut room, or traveling cart.

author: Neonix
summary_cn: 为游戏新增 20 种多肉植物和仙人掌作物。已更新至星露谷物语 1.6 版本，并完全转换为 Content Patcher 兼容格式。
summary: Adds 20 succulent and cactus crops to the game. Updated for Stardew 1.6 and fully converted to Content Patcher!

title_en: MBF More Crops Fruits and Forage (Formerly More Berries Fruits and Vegetables as Forage)
author: Aldino112
summary_cn:
新增 21 种浆果、84 种水果和 24 种蔬菜作为觅食材料。
新增农作物和果树。
summary:
Add 21 New Berries, add 84 New Fruits, add 24 New Vegetables as forage
Add Crops and Fruit Trees

title_en: MMF More Mushrooms as Forage - Aldino112
author: Aldino112
summary_cn: 新增 151 种蘑菇供你采摘。
summary: Add 151 NEW MUSHROOMS FOR YOU TO FORAGE

author: ganfantianzun
summary_cn: 降低钓鱼难度，使得玩家可以更轻易的钓上鱼，体验游戏乐趣。
summary: 降低钓鱼难度，使得玩家可以更轻易的钓上鱼，体验游戏乐趣。

author: ForgetfulDoryFish
summary_cn: 按下 V 键即可打开当前可钓获但尚未钓获的鱼类列表。这样可以方便地查看是否有值得立即垂钓的鱼类，而无需仔细追踪尚未钓获的鱼类的捕捉条件。
summary: Press the V key to open a list of the currently catchable fish that you haven't caught yet. This helps you easily check if there's something you should go catch right now, so you don't have to track the required circumstances for fish you're missing as closely.

name_cn: 鱼显示在哪里和如何捕获
author: Kitty Kaninka
summary_cn: 你是不是曾经钓到过某种鱼，却不知道该如何再次找到它。我经常遇到这个问题，所以我做了一个mod来解决这个问题。现在所有鱼类、蟹笼鱼等等的描述都已更改，会显示它们的获取地点和方法。
summary: Have you managed to get your hands on a fish, but don't know how to find it again? It is a problem i face often, so I made a mod to fix it. The description of all fish, crab pot fish etc. have now been changed to show where and how to catch them.

author: Len
summary_cn: 将钓鱼小游戏彻底改造为一款基于时机的节奏游戏。游戏特色包括动态难度、连击奖励、Boss 鱼的攻击模式以及宝藏。完全可自定义。
summary: Overhauls the fishing minigame into a timing-based rhythm game! Features dynamic difficulty, combo streaks, boss fish patterns, and treasures. Fully configurable. (Mod generated by AI)

author: Eunoia
summary_cn: 重新贴图和重新着色水滴鱼，并可选择将其恢复为健康的 Psychrolute。
summary: Retextures and recolours the blobfish and optionally returns it to a healthly Psychrolute.

author: linkoid
summary_cn: 提供统计数据，揭示最佳钓鱼地点，以实现利润最大化。
summary: Provides statistics revealing the best place to fish to maximize profit.

author: 13midnight
summary_cn: 为山谷增添更多天气模式。现在，天气会跟你作对。
summary: Adds more weather patterns to the valley. Now with weather that is angry at you.

author: Nature-w8AwA8w
summary_cn: 成为真正的冒险家。此模组在矿井中新增了 7 个独特的 Boss，每个 Boss 都有不同的难度设置和竞技场，并且都会掉落酷炫的服装和珍贵的材料。
summary: Become a true adventurer! This mod adds 7 new unique bosses to the mines with varying difficulty settings and arenas, each dropping cool costumes and valuable materials.

author: Vexorth
summary_cn: 这个模组允许你通过按 X 键随时随地睡觉（默认情况下可以修改 config.json 文件）。
summary: This mod allows you to sleep wherever you want by pressing X by default(you can change that in config.json)

author: Nature-w8AwA8w
summary_cn: Lunatic Shade 的 Skillful Clothes 定制版，为衬衫、裤子和帽子添加了更多技能和增益效果。此外，还增加了套装奖励、服装锻造和便携式衣橱功能。
summary: A custom rendition of Skillful Clothes by Lunatic Shade, adds even more skills and buffs to shirts, pants and hats. Adds set bonuses, clothing forge and portable wardrobe.

title_en: No Seeds For Coin - Seed Shortage
author: Pokky
summary_cn: 商店里已经下架了种子，所以你只能买到混合种子了。祝你好运。
summary: Removes seeds from shops, so you have to make do with mixed seeds. Good luck!

author: 404N0F
summary_cn: 添加了来自不同游戏和粉丝圈的物品，例如：Celeste、Deltarune、Minecraft、OMORI、The Backrooms、S.C.P. Foundation、Undertale、Vaporwave 和 Yume Nikki。
summary: Adds items from different Games and Fandoms like: Celeste, Deltarune, Minecraft, OMORI, The Backrooms, The S.C.P. Foundation, Undertale, Vaporwave and Yume Nikki

author: jpp
summary_cn: 使草地上随机生长出应季的、可采摘的花朵。
summary: Makes seasonal, harvestable flowers grow randomly on grass

author: TntDove
summary_cn: 将宝可梦中的树果添加到星露谷物语中，作为可种植作物。包含巨型作物和烹饪食谱。
summary: Adds the berries from Pokemon to Stardew Valley as growable crops. Includes giant crops and cooking recipes.

author: Damadelfalco
summary_cn:
吃腻了千篇一律的番茄。那就用番茄古老种子释放你内心的番茄爱好者吧。
全新番茄品种和食谱，带来丰富多样的美味佳肴。
summary:
Tired of the same old tomatoes? Then unleash your inner tomato lover with Tomato Ancient Seeds!
New tomato varieties and recipes with lots of dishes!

title_en: Rose's Cruelty Free Meat (Grow Animal Meat)
author: Roseloves109
summary_cn: 此模组允许你种植肉类和所有动物产品。该模组需要 Content Patcher 和 Extra Machine Configs 才能正常运行。
summary: Mods allows you to grow meat and all Animal Products. Mod needs Content Patcher and Extra Machine Configs to work

title_en: Machine Terrain Framework (and Aquatic Crops - formerly Custom Tapper Framework)
author: Selph aka zombifier
summary_cn: 一个用于添加可放置在树木、巨型作物和水体上的机器的框架。同时支持水生作物。
summary: A framework for adding machines that can be placed on trees, giant crops, and water. Also add water crops support.

name_cn: 若叶睦-苏联理想至高无上
author: Kozeki_Ui
summary_cn:
为鹈鹕镇新增了一位村民：若叶睦（和Mortis）。
位于博物馆的地下室；
人物原型来自BanGDream!中的乐队Ave Mujica。
summary:
为鹈鹕镇新增了一位村民：若叶睦（和Mortis）。
位于博物馆的地下室；
人物原型来自BanGDream!中的乐队Ave Mujica。

author: Paul Steele
summary_cn: 厌倦了每年夏天卖出数百万颗蓝莓。想尝试各种作物模组，却又忍不住追求极致收益。Ferngill Simple Economy 引入了一种随机经济系统，作物遵循基本的供求规律。
summary: Tired of selling millions of blueberries every summer? Want to try out various crop mods but can't resist the urge to min max? Ferngill Simple Economy introduces a randomized economy where crops follow basic rules of supply and demand. Sell too much of an item and its price may plummet! But play the market right and you might strike it big.

author: Mizzion
summary_cn: 为游戏添加银行功能。
summary: Adds a bank function to the game.

author: MissCoriel
summary_cn: 终于，一个功能齐全的投资系统诞生了。投资资金，建立经济体系。
summary: Finally, a fully functional Investment system! Invest money and establish Economics!!

author: Aimon111
summary_cn: 在皮埃尔的商店里增设捐款台，您可以向各种慈善机构捐款。
summary: Adds donation stand in Pierre's shop in which you can donate to various charity organisations.

author: YunHikari
summary_cn:
这是一个全新的对话技能，包含6种独特的职业。
该模组拥有大量动态对话，让你可以与其他村民交流。
你可以运用对话技能与村民交易，找到新的农场盈利途径。
summary:
This is a brand-new Conversation Skill with 6 unique professions.
The mod features tons of dynamic dialogue, letting you talk about other villagers with them.
You can trade with villagers using your conversation skills, finding new ways to profit for your farm.
Or help with simple tasks and compliment villagers to build friendship.

author: Selph aka zombifier
summary_cn: 销售新鲜优质农产品即可获得奖励。提高优质农作物和其他有机产品的售价，并举办为期一整个季节的比赛，评选出费恩吉尔共和国新鲜农产品种类最多的农场。
summary: Be rewarded for selling fresh, high quality produce. Increase sell price of high quality crops and other organic items, and add a season-long competition to crown the farm with the highest variety of fresh produce in all of the Ferngill Republic!

author: fox_white
summary_cn: 以可配置的方式修改肥料的各个方面，允许您在一个地块上施用多种肥料，允许您在作物生长后施用肥料，允许您修改每种肥料的加成。
summary: Modify aspects of fertilizers in a configurable way, allow you to apply multiple fertilizer to one tile, allow you to apply fertilizer after crop have grown, allow you to modify bonus from each fertilizers.

author: OchoEsLinda
summary_cn: 想升级到更高阶的洒水器，但家里却堆满了旧洒水器。别浪费了，升级它们吧。
summary: Ready for the next tier sprinkler, but you have all these old sprinklers laying around? Don't waste them, upgrade them!

author: weissnichts vom Leben
summary_cn:
你与店主的友好度会影响他们的定价。
完全可自定义。
summary:
Your friendship level with store owners affects their prices.
Fully customisable

author: Selph aka zombifier
summary_cn: 现在所有农场动物都会排泄粪便，这些粪便可以加工成肥料或生物燃料。
summary: Every farm animal now drops manure, which can be processed into fertilizer or biofuel.

author: Dhamos
summary_cn: 让您买入ZuzuCity的股票，几天后卖出即可获利。赚钱又赚钱。
summary: Allow you to buy stocks of ZuzuCity and sell it after some days with profit! Money making money!

author: aedenthorn
summary_cn: 它提供一部可自定义的手机，让你能够与朋友通话和接听电话，聊天或重温过去的精彩瞬间。它还能运行其他模组提供的移动应用。
summary: Gives you a customizable mobile phone that lets you call and receive calls from friends to chat or replay old events! It also runs mobile apps provided by other mods.

author: YunHikari
summary_cn: 当你的生命值或体力值较低时，自动摄取食物进行恢复。
summary: Automatically consume food to recover when your health or stamina is low!

author: YunHikari
summary_cn:
这款模组可以帮助农民自动浇灌作物，
简化繁琐的浇水过程。
只需装备浇水壶并靠近作物或锄地，即可自动浇水。
它还增强了探测范围，降低了漏浇作物的几率。
summary:
This mod helps farmers automatically water crops,
Simplifying the tedious watering process.
By equipping a WateringCan and approaching Crops or HoeDirt, it operates seamlessly.
It features enhanced range detection, reducing the chances of missing any crops that need watering.

author: YunHikari
summary_cn:
这个模组可以帮你省去点击鼠标的麻烦；你只需移动即可挖矿。
如果你注重游戏平衡，默认配置不会造成任何作弊问题。
如果你追求效率，可以修改配置来显著提高挖矿效率。
summary:
This mod can help you avoid the hassle of clicking the mouse; you can mine just by moving.
If you care about game balance, the default configuration won't raise any concerns about cheating.
If you pursue efficiency, you can modify the config to significantly increase mining efficiency.

author: YunHikari
summary_cn: 这个模组可以帮助你轻松挖掘文物、洞穴土壤，并用锄头准备耕种用的土壤。
